<translate>
'''The Strongest Armor''' is a special armor set that you can't craft: it is one of the wishes of [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]], the Earth dragon. The wish gives the whole set at once: '''The Strongest Chestplate''', '''Leggings''' and '''Boots'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

Gather the seven Earth Dragon Balls, summon Shenron and choose '''The Strongest Armor''' wish (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Protection ==

The pieces use the same Kikono armor material as the crafted sets, with the same armor points, toughness and knockback resistance (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor#Defense and resistance|Armor]]).
</translate>
